Package com.rpglab.game.utils

Class InputManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rpglab.game.utils.InputManager
  • public class InputManager
extends java.lang.Object
    Utility class for handling user input in the Dungeon Adventure RPG. This class provides robust input methods with validation and error handling to ensure a smooth user experience when interacting with the game through console input.

    The InputManager provides standardized methods for reading different types of user input including numbers, strings, yes/no responses, and pause functionality. All methods include appropriate error handling and user feedback for invalid input.

    Uses a single shared Scanner instance to avoid closing System.in prematurely.

    • Field Detail

      • scanner

        private static java.util.Scanner scanner
        Shared Scanner instance for all input operations. Using a single Scanner prevents System.in from being closed prematurely. Package-private (non-final) to allow test injection via reflection.

    • Method Detail

      • readWholeNumber

        public static int readWholeNumber​(java.lang.String message,
                                  int min,
                                  int max)
        Reads a whole number from user input within a specified range. Continues prompting the user until a valid integer within the range is entered. Handles empty input, non-numeric input, and out-of-range values gracefully.
        Parameters:
        message - The prompt message to display to the user
        min - The minimum allowed value (inclusive)
        max - The maximum allowed value (inclusive)
        Returns:
        A valid integer within the specified range
        Throws:
        java.lang.RuntimeException - if input is not available (system error)

      • readString

        public static java.lang.String readString​(java.lang.String message)
        Reads a string from user input with the specified prompt message. Automatically trims whitespace from the beginning and end of the input.
        Parameters:
        message - The prompt message to display to the user
        Returns:
        The user's input as a trimmed string

      • readYesNo

        public static boolean readYesNo​(java.lang.String message)
        Reads a yes/no response from user input. Accepts 'y' or 'n' (case-insensitive) and continues prompting until valid input. Provides clear feedback for invalid responses.
        Parameters:
        message - The prompt message to display to the user
        Returns:
        true if the user entered 'y', false if the user entered 'n'

      • waitForEnter

        public static void waitForEnter​(java.lang.String message)
        Pauses execution and waits for the user to press Enter. Useful for creating breaks in gameplay, allowing users to read messages before continuing with the game flow.
        Parameters:
        message - The message to display while waiting for user input

      • close

        public static void close()
        Closes the Scanner resource when the game is finished. Should be called before the application terminates to properly release system resources. Note: Once called, no further input operations will be possible.

      • resetScanner

        public static void resetScanner()
        Resets the scanner to use the current System.in. Public method primarily used for testing purposes. Allows tests to inject mock input streams.
